sloka: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं सुपर्णः शीघ्रविक्रमः ।रामं च विरुजं कृत्वा मध्ये तेषां वनौकसाम् ।। ६.५०.५९ ।।।।
transliteration: ityevamuktvā vacanaṁ suparṇaḥ śīghravikramaḥ ।rāmaṁ ca virujaṁ kṛtvā madhye teṣāṁ vanaukasām ।। 6.50.59 ।।।।

translations.english: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.
